strength: A clean, fast, fair 2-player push-your-luck loop with one real decision per turn, and tiny production cost.
weakness: The three advertised twists (bait, species majority, Lifebuoy refund) are close to inert in the data, so it plays as a generic shared-row duplicate-bust game that sits very near Port Royal.
required_changes: Fix the bait wording contradiction between the Overview, section 4 and section 5.
Add the 1-card river sentence, delete the dead 'other leftovers' text, and state what counts toward the refund.
Remove or clearly flag the untested 3-4 player variant.
Make bait worth leaving (for example a bust against bait lets the bait owner take a card from the opponent's pile) and re-run the simulation; target: leave-lowest under 60% against a smart leaver.
Species bonus: score per card of margin or raise to 12, and re-run (target: swings 10%+ of games), or drop species.
Refund: drop it, or move it to 3 cards with +4 for seat 2.
Check BGG for an existing 'leave one card' shared-row game, and do not call the river novel in the pitch.
